title: Headless export preview endpoint that returns anonymized sample rows for customer validation
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Problem: Customers scheduling large, recurring usage exports currently cannot validate their export configuration (schema mapping, column selection, redaction rules) without running a full export. Full exports are expensive and require waiting for scheduled jobs. We need a headless preview API that returns a small number of anonymized rows plus the resolved export schema so customers can iterate on configuration interactively and safely.
design_notes:
- Provide a POST /v1/exports/preview endpoint that accepts tenant_id, export_profile_id, sample_rows, and anonymization toggles.
- The service resolves the export query, materializes up to N rows from the latest on-disk snapshot or a cached query plan, applies deterministic anonymization (tenant HMAC salt + field-level rules), and returns schema + sample rows.
- Anonymization strategies: deterministic HMAC for ids, partial redaction for emails/phones, free-text PII redaction via configurable regex list.
- For performance, use a fast path against the export preview cache when available; fallback to a bounded scan of the latest usage window.
- Limit preview requests per tenant (default 10/min) and per-org total monthly budget to avoid abuse.
- Audit logging: every preview request emits an audit event referencing preview_id and user_id for compliance.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Endpoint returns schema and up to N sample rows within 3s for cached previews and within 8s for uncached previews for typical 30-day usage windows.
2) Sample rows have PII redacted according to policy; deterministic anonymization re-identifies across previews only within same tenant (HMAC salt).
3) Audit events created for every preview request containing preview_id, user_id, export_profile_id.
4) Rate limits in place and enforced; preview requests beyond quota return 429 with guidance.
5) UI and API docs updated with examples and security guidance.
implementation_plan:
- Spike/prototype (backend): implement preview runner that can materialize bounded rows from the export query and apply anonymization (3d).
- KMS & security review: choose approach for tenant HMAC salt storage (use envelope encryption with cloud KMS) (2d).
- Cache layer: extend export preview cache with TTL and invalidation when export profile changes (2d).
- API surface & auth: wire endpoint into console auth with RBAC check and audit logging (2d).
- Observability: add metrics (latency, cache hit, anonymization errors) and tracing (2d).
- Docs & Console: PM/Design produce UI preview copy and API docs (3d).
- QA & rollout: staged rollout behind feature flag (1d).
risks:
- Cost: generating previews for large tenants could be expensive if not cached or rate-limited. Mitigation: strict rate limits and per-tenant budget.
- Privacy: deterministic anonymization could leak linkage if tenant salt is compromised. Mitigation: store HMAC salt encrypted and rotate with KMS; log rotation events and invalidate previews.
- Consistency: preview rows might not match a later full export snapshot. Mitigation: clearly document that preview uses latest available snapshot and include snapshot_id in response.
qa_steps:
1) Unit tests for anonymization rules (determinism, edge cases).
2) Integration test between query runner and anonymizer with representative dataset.
3) Load test with synthetic tenants to validate rate limits and latency targets.
4) Security review to validate salt storage and audit logs.
5) Manual verification: run preview against existing export profiles and confirm schema and sample rows in UI.
comments: 2026-03-11 - Spike complete: prototype can materialize 50 rows from latest usage snapshot; applying deterministic HMAC on customer_id and partial email redaction implemented. Observed 30% CPU increase for uncached previews on a large tenant. Next: consider sampling from precomputed daily snapshot to reduce cost.

2026-03-12 - Design review with PM (Leah Chen) and Design (Jordan Park). Agreed on deterministic per-tenant HMAC salt and limited preview size default=5. UX wants an inline note: 'Previewed rows are anonymized and may differ from final export.'

2026-03-13 - Security flagged salt rotation complexity. Action: engage infra-security for KMS envelope approach. Added dependency on ENG-11234 to ensure snapshot access controls are respected by preview runner.

2026-03-14 - Implementation kickoff: backend owner assigned (Marco Silva). Feature flag: exports.preview.v1. Planning estimate 5 points. Next deliverable: PR with prototype and integration tests for anonymizer.
